entities.summary: Roberto de Oliveira Campos Neto is a Brazilian economist and former executive of Banco Santander. He served as the president of the Central Bank of Brazil until 31 December 2024. He is the grandson of Brazilian politician Roberto Campos, who was minister of planning during the Brazilian military dictatorship.
